summary: Both blocking findings are valid and require small spec changes before spec-gate.

items.title: Test-review header precheck has no specified structured data path
items.rationale: The spec requires coverage/header failures to stay non-semantic but does not yet identify the structured source of that classification.
items.evidence: spec.json R4 names coverage/header failures, and R5/T-4 cover test-review retry behavior; neither names test-coverage.json or an equivalent structured failure field.

items.title: Test-review repair loop ownership is ambiguous
items.rationale: The spec requires bounded fix/re-review but does not choose command-internal versus flow-level ownership or connect attempts to reviewRetry.
items.evidence: spec.json R5 and T-4 say test-review supports bounded fix/re-review attempts without defining the owner or budget consumption path.
